selection: Eighteen project-selected candidates, six per domain. Source content and missingness vary; no representative-sampling claim.

items.title: Ex Machina
items.evidence_text: A programmer visits a reclusive technology CEO at a private mountain estate. He must evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of an artificial intelligence named Ava, whose emotional intelligence is more deceptive than expected.

items.title: Coherence
items.evidence_text: The distributor describes a closely focused science-fiction relationship drama whose tension and mystery intensify quickly.

items.title: The Witch
items.evidence_text: A family settles beside an ominous forest in seventeenth-century New England. Unsettling events and the disappearance of a child lead to mounting paranoia and accusations within the family.

items.title: The Lighthouse
items.evidence_text: The studio describes a hypnotic, hallucinatory story about two lighthouse keepers isolated on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

items.title: After Yang
items.evidence_text: Jake searches for a way to repair his daughter's android companion. During this search he notices the life he has overlooked and reconnects with his wife and daughter.

items.title: A Ghost Story
items.evidence_text: A deceased man returns as a ghost to console his grieving wife. Unable to participate in life as before, he travels through memory and history, confronting questions of existence, loss and human connection.

items.title: The Martian
items.evidence_text: Astronaut Mark Watney is stranded alone on Mars after his crew believes him dead. Using engineering skills and ingenuity, he confronts successive survival problems in a hostile environment.

items.title: Piranesi
items.evidence_text: Piranesi records the halls, statues and tides of an immense House. New messages and an unknown visitor lead him to search for lost texts and uncover secrets as his familiar world becomes strange and dangerous.

items.title: Annihilation
items.source_kind: publisher-hosted introduction by Karen Joy Fowler
items.evidence_text: Explorers enter the isolated wilderness of Area X after earlier expeditions ended disastrously. Their investigation encounters unmapped structures and mysterious biological writing. The publisher-hosted introduction describes vivid surroundings that are beautiful yet threatening.

items.title: House of Leaves
items.evidence_text: The publisher presents a horror novel centered on a house larger inside than outside, and describes its reading experience as immersive and maze-like.

items.title: The Haunting of Hill House
items.evidence_text: A researcher looking for evidence of a haunting brings three others to the notoriously unfriendly Hill House. Unexplained events occur during their stay, and the house seems to choose one of them.

items.title: Record of a Spaceborn Few
items.evidence_text: Centuries after humanity leaves Earth, people in the Exodus Fleet consider what their lives and home mean. The publisher frames the story around belonging, tradition and finding a place in a changing universe.

items.title: bury a friend
items.source_kind: secondary article reporting the artist's explanation
items.evidence_text: Billie Eilish described this song as told from the perspective of a monster underneath a bed. Its presentation uses distorted vocals and unsettling production, linking the imagined creature with personal fears.

items.title: everything i wanted
items.evidence_text: This Billie Eilish song developed from a disturbing dream and feelings about fame. She and her brother Finneas reshaped it around their mutual support and understanding. The arrangement uses restrained piano and bass.

items.title: Red Right Hand
items.creators: Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds
items.source_kind: high-level interpretation of the official song text; no lyrics reproduced
items.evidence_text: The song portrays a threatening stranger amid ominous surroundings. Its narrative associates his influence with fear and danger.

items.title: Lean on Me
items.evidence_text: Bill Withers' song centers on people helping each other through difficulties and the support of a community.

items.title: Space Oddity
items.evidence_text: David Bowie's song tells of astronaut Major Tom and his flight into space, during which contact with Ground Control is lost.

items.title: Dream of Arrakis
items.evidence_text: Dream of Arrakis appears in the track list of the Dune soundtrack, whose score is written by Hans Zimmer. The supplied page identifies the track but does not describe its narrative or musical atmosphere.
